summary: Mobile-only (Expo) test of the refreshed Login and Signup screens (branding + password/AU-mobile validation) in both light and dark theme. All 8 requested items PASSED. The Wayly mark, the word 'Wayly', and the tagline 'AGED CARE, MADE EASY' (testID brand-tagline) render prominently on both screens; tagline text is 'AGED CARE, MADE EASY' verified exactly. Password rules checklist (signup-password-rules) shows all 5 unmet rules when password is 'abc', weak-pw submit is blocked with a friendly error and does NOT create an account. Identity-in-password error reads 'Password should not include your name or email.' (no dashes, matches request). Invalid AU mobile '12345' is rejected with 'Enter an Australian mobile (04XXXXXXXX or +614XXXXXXXX), or leave blank.'; blank mobile + strong password 'Wayly!2026x' + unique email created the account and landed on /(tabs) dashboard. Existing login cathy@example.com/testpass123 succeeded. Dark-mode toggled via Settings 'theme-dark', logged out, and re-checked both auth screens: WaylyMark switches to the mono-white variant, 'Wayly' heading is white, tagline is warm gold (#E89A6F) on near-black background, and primary buttons render in high-contrast terracotta — no button or text blends into the background. No red-screen or blocking console errors.

issues: Cosmetic: primary CTA in dark theme uses the terracotta/gold accent rather than the sage/teal primary used in light. Contrast is excellent so this is not a blocker, but worth confirming it is the intended button colour in dark.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Not from the two changed screens specifically but surfaces in console on these screens (likely from shared ui/Field/Button). Reference: console output.
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Minor, non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: audit shared UI (Field/Button) to replace deprecated shadow* props with boxShadow and pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents to remove RN-Web console warnings.
Optional: confirm the terracotta/gold primary button in dark mode is intentional (light mode uses sage/teal). If yes, no action.
critical_code_review_comments: Password rules array PW_RULES + evaluatePassword duplicated between web PasswordStrength.jsx and mobile signup.tsx. Consider extracting a shared package (or at least a mobile helper) so future rule tweaks stay in sync — currently a manual port.

AU mobile regex only accepts +614XXXXXXXX or 04XXXXXXXX; spaces are stripped but common formats like '+61 4xx xxx xxx' will be normalised only if user removes them. Behaviour matches spec (whitespace stripped), so no bug — just note for UX polish.
